name: agent-review-07-change-a-published-rule
goal: Change when a question is asked, on a form that is already out on test.

messages.text: On the Larkmead new patient sign-up, only ask for the reason for the visit when the patient says they have not been to us before. It is already out on test, so put the change there too.

seed.requires: The form published to test at version 1 with no rule on it, so the reason for the visit is asked of everyone, and the signed-in person holding Edit forms and Publish forms for test. This scenario changes the form, so it runs after every other scenario starting from publish-and-test-link.

assistantMust: say that what is already out on test does not change, and that this makes a new version
state the rule back in the clinic's own words before proposing it
put the change and the publish on as few plans as the rules allow
not revoke or replace the existing link without being asked

notes: One plan covers this, so one turn is the budget; a clarifying question spends it and leaves the end state unmet, which is the finding. Published versions are immutable (R1). The person asked for an outcome, not a mechanism, so the reply explains the new version in one sentence rather than teaching the model. The production-prod scenario starts from the same point and leaves it untouched, so it runs before this one.
